targets.proteinNote: 1.4–1.6 g/kg target body weight; preserves LBM in deficit
targets.carbsNote: Sufficient for cognitive function & training performance
targets.fatNote: Minimum 0.8 g/kg; hormone production & nutrient absorption
targets.waterMlNote: Baseline; increase with activity & ambient temperature

principles: 1. ENERGY DEFICIT: A sustained caloric deficit of 300–500 kcal/day produces fat loss of 0.4–0.6 kg/week while minimising lean tissue catabolism.
2. PROTEIN PRIORITISATION: Protein intake ≥1.4 g/kg target weight preserves muscle mass, increases diet-induced thermogenesis, and enhances satiety signalling.
3. MICRONUTRIENT DENSITY: Minimum 5 servings/day of vegetables and 2 servings/day of fruit to ensure adequate fibre, vitamins, and phytonutrients.
4. MEAL FREQUENCY: 3 main meals + 1–2 snacks distributed across 10–12 hours supports stable blood glucose and reduces unplanned eating.
5. HYDRATION PROTOCOL: 250–500ml water upon waking; 250ml before each meal; additional intake during and after physical activity.
6. ADHERENCE MECHANISM: One flexible meal (≤800 kcal) per week to support psychological sustainability and social participation without compromising weekly deficit.
7. PROGRESS MONITORING: Weigh-in once weekly (morning, post-void, pre-breakfast, consistent clothing); track 7-day rolling average rather than daily fluctuations.
8. SLEEP & RECOVERY: 7–9 hours sleep; sleep restriction impairs ghrelin/leptin regulation and increases hedonic food cravings by 24–45%.
